goal: Finish the KGEN 11520 mobile control package: center the normal-axis energy rail; use signed C as direction (+C=多, -C=空, 0C neutral); keep lots positive; provide persistent configurable long/short color presets; allow both slider/touch and precise numeric entry for C and lots; preserve immersive visible-viewport/fullscreen behavior and the existing confirmation path.

semantics.signed_c: +C=LONG/多, -C=SHORT/空, 0C=neutral; negative C is reverse velocity direction, never negative mass.
semantics.numeric_c: Direct entry accepts -1000..+1000 and resolves to the nearest existing canonical C level so UI, game state and order state cannot diverge.
semantics.numeric_lots: Direct entry accepts integer lots and clamps to 1..100; it drives the existing canonical lot control rather than creating parallel state.
semantics.color_default: TW_RED_LONG: 多/LONG red (#ff4f5e), 空/SHORT green (#35d07f).
semantics.color_alternate: GLOBAL_GREEN_LONG: 多/LONG green, 空/SHORT red.
semantics.order_safety: Slider movement, numeric entry, color changes and direction selection do not execute an order; existing order confirmation remains mandatory.

machine_verifiable_acceptance: 390x844 Chromium proves #yControl center within 2px of viewport center and Y-C-lot rails do not overlap.
Slider/touch proves 0C, +C=多, -C=空 and signed combat-drive propagation.
Numeric C input proves -0.1 produces -0.1C and SHORT without opening an order flow.
Numeric lots input proves 7 -> 7口 and negative input clamps to 1口.
Default Taiwan colors and alternate international colors are both machine-verified and persisted.
Immersive fallback matches VisualViewport and keeps an explicit exit.
Mandatory signed-C screenshot exists and existing 11520 visual/regression gates remain active.
merge_policy: R1 only. Merge only from exact latest main/head after required exact-head checks are green and no blocking comments/threads/races exist. Then verify post-merge exact main and Pages.
